posts.title: I’m in a music video! “Takeover” by Mia Jomor
posts.description: A couple of months ago, I joined a bunch of skaters at Cal Skate to participate in a music video shoot for local R&B artist Mia Jomor. We shot for like a couple of hours and I had no idea if any of it would make the final cut. Here’s the final product. So nice seeing Satise, Lainie, Angie, Yelena, Peter Paul and Mike feature in several shots!

posts.title: On Jury Duty, Implicit Bias, and Critical Thinking
posts.description: IMAGE CREDIT: Judicial Council of California I just finished my jury duty for the year and it was a fascinating experience. I am proud to serve on jury duty, which is one of the only things our country requires every citizen to do for the good of the nation and our community. It’s always an interesting glimpse into a diverse cross-section of my city, from all walks of life. In the room with me during jury selection there was a meter maid, a make up artist, a stay at home dad, a couple of grad students, an investor, a special ed teacher, and many, many engineers for tech companies. For this round of jury duty, I was called for jury selection (“voir dire”) on the first day of my service. About sixty of us were packed into the gallery of an old court room of the criminal court house on 850 Bryant. posts.title: Halloween 2026 Costumes: Back to the 50s!
posts.description: This year, Satise and I did our first couple’s costume, a tribute to the 1950s. It was actually a pretty easy set of costumes to put together. Satise already had a carhop costume from a gig she did years ago. And so all I had to do was look era appropriate. I decided to do a 50s style “greaser” or bad boy, ala “Greased Lightning.” It was fun going to different skate events and parties in these outfits. Satise even had a cute tray for handing out treats. How adorable is she?
